comments.zh: Runtime×ORM 演示场景集 — Fluent DTO + EFCore/FreeSql AsDto 双态：
comments.en: Runtime × ORM demonstration scenario set — Fluent DTO + EFCore/FreeSql AsDto dual-state:

comments.zh: 纯可翻译声明走投影（SQL 侧列裁剪）；Mask 声明一律强制降级（内存映射 + 脱敏不落明文）。
comments.en: Purely translatable declarations use projection (column pruning on the SQL side); Mask declarations are always forcibly downgraded (in-memory mapping + obfuscation without storing plaintext).

comments.zh: EFCore 纯可翻译 Fluent DTO 投影：AsDto 正常返回（SQL 侧列裁剪）。
comments.en: EFCore purely translatable Fluent DTO projection: AsDto returns normally (column pruning on the SQL side).

comments.zh: <returns>投影后的 Fluent DTO 列表</returns>
EFCore 含 Mask 声明的 Fluent DTO：一律强制降级（内存映射承载，不抛异常、脱敏不落明文）。
comments.en: EFCore Fluent DTO containing Mask declarations: always forcibly downgraded (in-memory mapping, no exceptions thrown, obfuscation without storing plaintext).

comments.en: FreeSql purely translatable Fluent DTO projection.
